protocol: feature-space perturbation (train-std normalized), black-box, equal epsilon budget
finding: RF is far more robust to adversarial perturbation. Under feature perturbation (eps=0.1) the LLM macro-F1 collapses from 0.93 to 0.04; evasion 55.9% (RF 0%). Two independent measurements agree.
caveat: The magnitude of the LLM collapse reflects the OOD fragility of the feature-to-text representation (all features perturbed at once + full-value text encoding + narrow fine-tune). The direction is reliable (two measurements agree); the magnitude should be explained mechanistically. It may improve with robust/adversarial training -> future work. Perturbation is in feature space (packet realizability is separate).
